description: Free, no key, instant result. Without api_key: 5 own checks per client address per UTC day, shared by check_book and the finance tools; samples are never counted. A free key (get_free_key, no card, no e-mail) runs 20 own checks a day and 200 in all. Try it now: call with no arguments, or with sample=true, to run the published sample (made-up figures, no key, never counted against the caps) and see real flags; the result ends with next, the fields to send for your own data. Send a dataset as a list of row dicts (JSON) or a CSV string; checks null rate per field (flagged when above max_null_rate, default 0.2), type inconsistencies within a field (number / bool / string, nulls excluded), exact duplicate rows, and numeric outliers (values beyond Q1 − 3×IQR or Q3 + 3×IQR, requires ≥ 4 non-null values per field). Schema-drift excluded from v1. Process-and-discard: nothing is stored or logged after the run. A request containing a Luhn-valid card number or a valid IBAN is refused before accept with reason sensitive_data_refused (not counted as a check). Desk: volume use. Top-level verdict is CLEAN or FLAGGED.

api_key.description: Optional key (vdk_...). Same as the Bearer header.

csv.description: Dataset as a CSV string with a header row (CSV mode). Mutually exclusive with 'rows'.

max_null_rate.description: Null-rate threshold 0.0–1.0; fields above this are flagged. Default 0.2.

rows.description: Dataset as a list of row dicts (JSON mode). Mutually exclusive with 'csv'.

sample.description: true runs the published sample (made-up figures) instead of your data; a call with no arguments does the same. Never counted against the caps.
